fullPassage: For creatures like us, evolution smiled upon those with a strong need to belong. Survival and reproduction are the criteria of success by natural selection, and forming relationships with other people can be useful for both survival and reproduction. Groups can share resources, care for sick members, scare off predators, fight together against enemies, divide tasks so as to improve efficiency, and contribute to survival in many other ways. In particular, if an individual and a group want the same resource, the group will generally prevail, so competition for resources would especially favor a need to belong. Belongingness will likewise promote reproduction, such as by bringing potential mates into contact with each other, and in particular by keeping parents together to care for their children, who are much more likely to survive if they have more than one caregiver.

questions.passage: For creatures like us, (A)[revolution / evolution] smiled upon those with a strong need to belong. Survival and (B)[reproduction / destruction] are the criteria of success by natural selection, and forming relationships with other people can be useful for both survival and reproduction. Groups can share resources, care for sick members, scare off predators, fight together against enemies, divide tasks so as to improve efficiency, and (C)[contribute to / detract from] survival in many other ways. In particular, if an individual and a group want the same resource, the group will generally prevail, so competition for resources would especially favor a need to belong. Belongingness will likewise promote reproduction, such as by bringing potential mates into contact with each other, and in particular by keeping parents together to care for their children, who are much more likely to survive if they have more than one caregiver.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① revolution — reproduction — contribute to: (A) revolution(혁명)은 evolution(진화)과 다른 의미
✅ ② evolution — reproduction — contribute to: 원문 일치. 진화(evolution)는 소속 욕구가 강한 자에게 미소 짓고, 생존과 번식(reproduction)이 자연선택의 기준이며, 생존에 기여한다(contribute to)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ evolution — destruction — contribute to: (B) destruction(파괴)은 reproduction(번식)의 반의어
❌ ④ revolution — destruction — detract from: 3개 모두 오류

questions.passage: For creatures like us, evolution smiled upon those with a strong need to belong. Survival and reproduction are the criteria of success by natural selection, and forming relationships with other people can be useful for both survival and reproduction. Groups can share resources, care for sick members, scare off (A)[protectors / predators], fight together against enemies, divide tasks so as to improve efficiency, and contribute to survival in many other ways. In particular, if an individual and a group want the same resource, the group will generally (B)[prevail / surrender], so competition for resources would especially favor a need to belong. Belongingness will likewise (C)[hinder / promote] reproduction, such as by bringing potential mates into contact with each other, and in particular by keeping parents together to care for their children, who are much more likely to survive if they have more than one caregiver.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① protectors — prevail — promote: (A) protectors(보호자)는 predators(포식자)와 반대 의미
❌ ② predators — surrender — promote: (B) surrender(항복하다)는 prevail(우세하다)의 반의어
✅ ③ predators — prevail — promote: 원문 일치. 포식자(predators)를 쫓아내고, 집단이 우세하며(prevail), 소속감이 번식을 촉진한다(promote)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ predators — prevail — hinder: (C) hinder(방해하다)는 promote(촉진하다)의 반의어

questions.passage: For creatures like us, evolution smiled upon those with a strong need to belong. Survival and reproduction are the criteria of success by __________, and forming relationships with other people can be useful for both survival and reproduction. Groups can share resources, care for sick members, scare off predators, fight together against enemies, divide tasks so as to improve efficiency, and contribute to survival in many other ways. In particular, if an individual and a group want the same resource, the group will generally prevail, so competition for resources would especially favor a need to belong. Belongingness will likewise promote reproduction, such as by bringing potential mates into contact with each other, and in particular by keeping parents together to care for their children, who are much more likely to survive if they have more than one caregiver.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① mutual cooperation: 상호 협력 — 성공의 기준을 설명하는 맥락에 부적합
✅ ② natural selection: 자연 선택 — 생존과 번식이 자연선택(natural selection)에 의한 성공의 기준이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ group survival: 집단 생존 — 자연선택이라는 과학적 개념을 지칭하는 맥락에 부적합
❌ ④ social bonding: 사회적 유대 — 성공의 기준을 설명하는 맥락에 부적합
det.tip: by natural selection = 자연 선택에 의해

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① endanger the population: 인구를 위협하다 — 집단의 이점을 나열하는 맥락에 반대
❌ ② reduce group efficiency: 집단 효율을 낮추다 — 집단의 이점을 나열하는 맥락에 반대
❌ ③ weaken individual bonds: 개인 유대를 약화시키다 — 집단의 이점을 나열하는 맥락에 반대
✅ ④ contribute to survival: 생존에 기여하다 — 자원 공유, 포식자 퇴치 등과 함께 생존에 기여한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: contribute to survival in many other ways = 다른 여러 방식으로 생존에 기여하다
